title: Compose positive relative certificates through correlated reaction entrances
statement: Entrywise aL_t<=K_t<=bL_t propagates through every nonnegative entrance and common exact later positive operator. An input certificate a0 L0<=M0<=b0 L0 yields a0 a L0 L_t<=M0 K_t<=b0 b L0 L_t. Each approximate reuse multiplies spread; normalized TV is bounded by (sqrt(b/a)-1)/(sqrt(b/a)+1).

assumptions: event likelihoods need input mass calibration
new mark/lag/source may require new construction
costs: repeated phases may multiply branches or bonds
contract.units: dimensionless relative spread and TV; event density retains inverse-time units
contract.obstruction: Additive absolute error does not automatically preserve rare-event accuracy; reusing a table does not erase its approximation error.

evidence.quote: Source acquisition can be reused; approximation error is not waived by reuse.

review.scope: Exact source-supported extraction only; any scoped substantive acceptance is a separate version-bound review overlay.
